errors.evidence: The description mislocates the 'Селско стопанство' (Agriculture) slice. It is not in the upper right quadrant between 'Индустрия' (Industry) and 'Транспорт' (Transport). It is in the upper left portion of the chart, between 'Домакинства' (Households) and 'Индустрия' (Industry).
The description incorrectly states that the percentage labels are inside the chart. The labels for the percentages are located outside the donut ring.

errors.text_span: Секторите визуално са подредени по низходящ ред на големината им, започвайки от най-големия „Транспорт“ и продължавайки по часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the sectors are arranged in descending order by size. The clockwise sequence of percentages starting from 'Транспорт' (34.6%) is 12.6%, 22.9%, 1.9%, and 28.0%, which is not a descending order.
